facts.text: Cedric and Warwick say shipments into Brandonsford stopped when the dragon troubles began; what exactly is stopping them, including Bentley's overdue restock?

classification.grounding_justification: Two townsfolk tie the halt to the dragon's arrival, but nobody says how the dragon stops caravans, leaving the mechanism conspicuously open.
classification.investigative_depth_justification: The answer would reveal the underlying circumstance cutting off the town, possibly connected to the dragon's true nature.
classification.narrative_payoff_justification: Knowing what really halts the caravans would change the party's understanding of the town's plight.
classification.investigative_potential_justification: It can be pursued by questioning merchants or tracing the caravan route.

facts.text: Cedric and Warwick say supplies have not reached Brandonsford since the dragon appeared; until the caravans flow again, Cedric cannot pay out his promissory note for the party's treasure.

classification.scope_basis: The supply halt has lasted weeks to months and Cedric's payment is explicitly conditioned on caravans flowing again, so it persists beyond the store scene.
